program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([r (in-range (rows g))])
    (let ((cols-hit (for/list ([c (in-range (cols g))] #:when (= (at g r c) 5)) c)))
      (if (= (length cols-hit) 2)
          (let ((c1 (first cols-hit)) (c2 (second cols-hit)))
            (if (and (> c2 (+ c1 1))
                     (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 0)) (range (+ c1 1) c2)))
                (for/fold ([acc out]) ([c (in-range (+ c1 1) c2)])
                  (set-cell acc r c 3))
                out))
          out))))
